تحتكري (form VIII)
# تَحْتَكِرِي (taḥtakirī) /taħ.ta.ki.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# تُحْتَكَرِي (tuḥtakarī) /tuħ.ta.ka.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
